edits.reason: Preserve original six classes/Zeus then construct two additional hubs
Normalize 64-byte buffers to the known 23-byte ID1 prefix
Unmatched devices use existing DefaultAddressing instead of consuming a known-device driver
Record parent/port only in the two owned extra-hub objects
Release the correct mapped hub subtree on disconnect; preserve original port-event processing

limitations: Normal report layout restored; physical PS5 behavior is not verified
Unmatched devices receive an address without acquiring an input driver
Parent/port tracking uses padding only in the two owned extra-hub objects
Physical reconnect timing and PS5 behavior remain unverified
